limits: AC current directions are unsupported because native values are complex phasors.
MOS drain-terminal arrows include displacement current; current is not assumed to flow exclusively into the source.
Only actual named single-MOS D/S anchors currently have spatial mappings. Inverter, testbench, resistor/source and imported-GDS branches remain unmapped, including imports with app sidecars.
Paths are terminal-anchor links, not reconstructed conductor current-density fields.
Post-layout flow records core MOS and active voltage-source branches; distributed extracted R/C currents are not included.
